column2: [intro]
In my kitchen, cutlery flies through the air,
Glasses break, it's no big deal!
But hey, it creates a lively atmosphere,
Mess is life, gotta have a blast!
I don't see the point in tidying my room,
If it’s not sparkling, it's too dull, it's a gloom!
I love living in a joyful, colorful mess,
Cause mess is life, time to confess!
In my living room, there are toys everywhere,
And papers lying around, it's not very neat!
But hey, it makes this house lively,
Mess is life, gotta laugh out loud!
I don’t see the point in folding my clothes,
As long as it makes my friends laugh, it’s impressive!
My wardrobe overflows with mismatched stuff,
Cause mess is life, let’s make it clear!
[ solo ]
So, leave me in my joyful, silly mess,
Cause mess is life, it's not that complex!
We don’t care about tidying, just having fun,
And enjoying every moment, until the day is done!
[outro]
